authorization.rationale: Three of four Branch 303 rows lack authorization references while comparison branches retain them. Audit the source system and process; missing references alone do not prove unauthorized opening.

market-capacity.rationale: AXL claims exceed the complete matching tape by only 0.8%. The group is inconsistent, but the case file cannot identify which confirmation is false or who caused the conflict.

number-pattern.rationale: The West cohort is designed with evenly spaced dollar components and sequential cents endings. That makes it a document-review target, but four records cannot establish fabrication or justify a formal distribution test.

round-total.rationale: Three Alder records on the same date sum exactly to 50,000. Request receipts, approval, purpose, and payment evidence; the pattern alone does not establish misconduct.
